scope: ODA v5.4.1 DataStorage inline/blob record span enforcement and generated tests

sourceAuthority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
sourceAuthority.rule: A record span ends at the next consecutive payload stream offset or, for the last record, at the segment end. The inline record's 4-byte size field plus dataSize must fit. Direct byte arrays are at most 0x40000 bytes; larger byte arrays use the blob-reference marker.

changes.detail: Added the named 0x40000 inline-payload maximum from ODA §24.2.2.3.
Builds a sorted payload-local-offset index per data segment; bounds direct records and full blob descriptors by the next record or segment end; rejects oversized direct payloads.

Adds generated in-memory exact-limit and over-limit direct payloads, direct-record overlap and blob-descriptor overlap negatives, and suffix-record survival assertions alongside the existing two-page reversed-physical-order test.
